name: Weekend Renters
storyline:
After your grandpa passed away, you inherited his old cozy cabin just outside the city. With no real use for it, you decided to rent it out. Every Monday, you drive there to clean and get it ready for the next guests. Everything seems normal... until disturbing little details begin to surface.

Will you dare to look closer?
summary:
Preparing a cabin for guests... what could go wrong?
"Weekend Renters" is a short retro-style indie horror game.
